programmes.d: The Cherokee Indian racing team is experiencing a lot of problems with their cars and drivers. A rival team wants to make sure the Cherokee does not win the races. Meanwhile, a young girl is kidnapped so Trent and Carlos search for her.
A Cherokee driver is injured by a rival racing team. Walker takes his place in the race.

Models are being kidnapped to be sold in a sex-slavery auction. Trivette's girlfriend is the most recent disappearance. The Rangers must find where the models are being held before the sale is finished.

A crime lord named Caleb Hooks, whom Walker helped put in prison several years ago, escapes from prison, hell bent on revenge against the Texas Rangers (because Hooks' brother had been shot and killed during a shootout, and he claims it was murder).
Kimble is held as a virtual prisoner by an old man who has shunned civilization for fourteen years.
A seedy professional mind reader recognizes Richard Kimble and believes he's found the means to a comeback in a show business.
A new witness, one who saw the one-armed man, comes forward on behalf of Dr. Richard Kimble.
MacGyver battles the mob while protecting an elderly couple who have unwittingly become mixed up in a syndicate counterfeiting operation.
Trapped inside the Phoenix Foundation by a group of terrorists, MacGyver races against a ticking bomb to save his life and that of his grandfather's.
MacGyver is the Thorntons only hope when they are taken hostage in the swamps of Louisiana by an ex-agent seeking revenge.
The investigation of a country star's murder revolves around a driven TV producer (Barbara Mandrell) and her daughter, a timid songwriter.
A psychiatrist murders his estranged wife and frames a patient for the crime.
A sultry but sinister pharmaceutical rep is dead set on winning the heart of the hospital's chief of staff.
A beach boy involved with a gang member's sister is a suspect in his murder.
A surgeon (Wayne Rogers) drops dead while he's operating on another doctor (Jack Klugman).
Donna and James wonder why Maddy left so suddenly. Norma's mother arrives with news…she's married a new man, Ernie Niles. Cooper tells Leland they arrested Ben Horne for Laura's murder.
Albert returns to examine Maddy. Cooper asks for twenty-four hours to finish his case. James and Donna reaffirm their love. Andy accidentally leads Donna and Cooper back to Mrs. Tremond's house.

Leland is laid to rest and Sarah Palmer tries to accept all that has happened to her family. Dr. Jacoby returns from Hawaii. Cooper prepares to leave Twin Peaks. Mayor Milford objects to his brothers engagement to a younger woman.
Hunter searches for the killer of a runaway girl whose baby he helped to deliver.
McCall's friend and former training officer comes to LA for a visit in the midst of a murder investigation and goes quite overboard trying to help her out.
Overcome with guilt over the suicide of her training officer, McCall quits the force and is kidnapped. Hunter sets out to rescue her before it's too late.
A pilot of an airliner carrying Dr. Sloan and Amanda to a medical conference in Europe is murdered.
A wealthy woman and her lover concoct an elaborate scheme to do in her husband.
A comedian (Tim Conway) makes a bumbling attempt to do in his more successful former partner (Harvey Korman)---whose wife turns up dead.
